'''2007 Worlds Team Angelo Consoli DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Angelo Consoli]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Team Best Couple. Random Hunt Down. No Escape struck; kept for 60. 10 shields on sheet.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Angelo Consoli]]

* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out From The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
